name: Determinant of a two by two matrix
subject: linear_algebra

conditions: A is a 2 by 2 matrix with first row (a,b) and second row (c,d), over real or complex scalars.
spoken_aliases: the determinant of matrix a equals entry a times entry d minus entry b times entry c
determinant of matrix a equals the product of entries a and d minus the product of entries b and c

evidence: Expand the determinant along the first row: the first minor is d with positive sign, and the second minor is c with negative sign. Thus the determinant is ad-bc.

Reference cross-check: https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/7-8-solving-systems-with-cramers-rule. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
